entry.title: New: Resolution 380 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE DAUGHTERS OF HAWAI‘I TO ASSIST WITH IRRIGATION SYSTEM REPAIRS TO PRESERVE THE ROYAL BANYAN TREE AT HULIHE‘E PALACE

Transfers $4,800 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 7)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 380-23 - 12/20/23
